home.hero_title: Private Higher School of Agricultural Sciences and Technologies

admission_page.intro: Choose your program, check the entry requirements, prepare your application: here is everything you need to know to join AGRI'SUP. The team supports you at every step.
admission_page.conditions_intro: Your entry point depends on your qualification: baccalaureate, BT, DUT or bachelor's degree.
admission_page.conditions_guidance: Not sure which program or level suits you? Talk to the AGRI'SUP team before preparing your application: their guidance is free.
admission_page.documents_intro: Documents to gather for your enrolment:
admission_page.documents_guidance: The enrolment form is provided by the school. Start with the online pre-registration: the team will contact you to complete your application.
admission_page.step_1_description: Compare the professional bachelor's degrees and DUT programs, then choose the one that matches your plans.
admission_page.step_2_description: Make sure your qualification matches the level you are aiming for; the team can advise you.
admission_page.step_3_description: The online form takes a few minutes and sends your first details.
admission_page.step_4: Be contacted by AGRI'SUP to complete your application
admission_page.step_4_description: The team contacts you with the list of documents to provide and the next steps.
admission_page.step_5_description: Submit your complete application and follow the school's guidance until you are enrolled.
admission_page.disclaimer: Online pre-registration is for sending your first details. It does not mean final admission.
admission_page.questions_text: The AGRI'SUP team can answer by phone, WhatsApp or through the contact form.
admission_page.fees_intro: Amounts per academic year, in CFA francs.
admission_page.advantages_intro: Studying at AGRI'SUP also means practical support, from enrolment to your first job.

agrisup_page.intro: A private higher school of agricultural sciences and technologies in Sotuba ACI, Bamako, building on nearly twenty years of experience in agropastoral training.
agrisup_page.pedagogy_intro: The learning path connects theoretical knowledge with fieldwork, all the way to employment.
agrisup_page.infrastructures_intro: Equipped spaces for learning by doing.
agrisup_page.infra_lab_text: Microscopes and stereo microscopes for practical work in biology, analysis and animal health.
agrisup_page.infra_computer_text: Workstations for office software, statistics and management.
agrisup_page.infra_classroom_text: Rooms suited to lectures and tutorials.
agrisup_page.infra_field_text: An experimental field and equipment, including a tractor, for hands-on practice close to the crops.
agrisup_page.lmd_intro: AGRI'SUP follows the LMD system (bachelor's, master's, doctorate), an international-standard higher education model organised in semesters and based on accumulating credits. Three degree levels are offered after the baccalaureate.
agrisup_page.partners_intro: To ensure quality training and help our graduates find work, AGRI'SUP relies on leading partners in Mali and abroad: internships, field visits, technical expertise and scholarship opportunities.

legal_page.intro: Legal information about this website and how your personal data is processed.
legal_page.draft: Provisional text, to be legally validated by AGRI'SUP before going live.
legal_page.database_text: Form data is stored in a PostgreSQL database hosted by Neon, on servers located in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). Email notifications are sent through Resend.
legal_page.data_collected: Data collected: through the contact form (name, email or phone, subject, message) and the pre-registration form (last name, first name, phone, optional email, city, level of education, desired program and academic year, optional message).
legal_page.data_purpose: Purpose: this data is only used to answer your requests and process your pre-registration. It is never sold or used for advertising.
legal_page.data_basis: Legal basis: your consent, given by ticking the box in each form.
legal_page.data_recipients: Recipients: authorised AGRI'SUP staff, and the technical providers needed to run the website (hosting, database, email delivery).
legal_page.data_security: Security: exchanges are encrypted (HTTPS); IP addresses used to limit abusive submissions are never stored in plain text.
legal_page.rights_text: In accordance with Law No. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 on the protection of personal data in the Republic of Mali, you have the right to access, correct, object to and delete your data. To exercise these rights, contact AGRI'SUP through the Contact page. You may also contact the Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP).
legal_page.cookies_locale: Language: a technical cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers your language choice.
legal_page.cookies_theme: Theme: your light or dark theme choice is saved in your browser's local storage and is not transmitted.
legal_page.cookies_youtube: Video: the presentation video is only loaded from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com domain) if you click "play". YouTube may then set its own trackers.
legal_page.cookies_maps: Map: the Google Maps map is only loaded if you click "Show the map".
legal_page.ip_text: The content of this website (texts, logo, visuals) belongs to AGRI'SUP unless otherwise stated. Any reproduction without permission is prohibited.
legal_page.credits: Icons: Heroicons (MIT licence) and Font Awesome Free (CC BY 4.0 licence, fontawesome.com). Carousel: Embla Carousel (MIT licence).

slider.label: AGRI'SUP at a glance
slider.s1_text: Practice-based agricultural training for a secure future: DUT, bachelor's and master's degrees in agricultural sciences and technologies, in the heart of Bamako.
slider.s2_text: Crop production, livestock and animal health, aquaculture, agribusiness and agroforestry: discover the fields taught at AGRI'SUP.
slider.s3_text: Choose your program, check the entry requirements and send your pre-registration online: the team supports you at every step.
slider.s4_title: Partners in Mali and around the world
slider.s4_text: IPR/IFRA Katibougou, IER, Purdue University and many more: our partnerships give students access to internships, field visits and scholarship opportunities.
